answer:
The four strategies correspond to four models: Model I "Basic", Model II "BERT", Model III "Tag", and Model IV "Meta".

The paper presents these as "our four learning strategies" evaluated in three settings (DOMAIN, OUT-OF-DOMAIN, and CROSS-DATASET) [4], with the results table listing Model I Basic, Model II BERT, Model III Tag, and Model IV Meta [6]. Model IV uses a meta-learning strategy that bridges the communication gap between domains when updating shared parameters [9], and Model II uses BERT, which shows some domain generalization ability within the dataset [8].
